name: sessions
description: How the sessions Vyre starts run (ADR 0030): the Claude Agent SDK driver's status and install, and the system prompt at three levels, versioned.

tips.text: Run `vyre call sessions.status` to see which driver, sign-in and Claude Code your sessions run on.
A session nobody uses closes after 10 minutes and comes back on your next message. Set `idle_minutes` to change it.
Pick the model per purpose with `sessions.models.set`, for example scope `purpose:capsule` and model `sonnet`.
Give every Northwind Bakery session a house rule: `sessions.prompt.set` with scope `project:northwind-bakery`.
See what a Harlow Legal session will be told before it starts: `sessions.prompt.preview` with that project.
Undo a prompt edit with `sessions.prompt.revert` to an older version. Going back is a version too, so it undoes.
Install the Agent SDK now instead of on first use with `vyre call sessions.setup`.
Keep an API key in the vault and a session that hits your subscription limit carries on under it, and says so.
A prompt edit applies from the next session, never to one in the middle of a conversation.
